cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before we sell this bottled cloud, measure from its third elbow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the new assistant. I can only find two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Naturally. The third appears when addressed by its professional title. Say 'Professor.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Professor. It's raining inside the bottle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Those are its credentials. Count the drops; that gives us its sleeve size.

mechanism: A corrects an assistant's measurement of a bottled cloud by inventing confident rules precisely when missing anatomy and rain make them necessary.
confusable: D150 discovers a rule from tests; D162 performs mastery and invents rules opportunistically without acknowledging uncertainty.
comparison: Sales measurement and a novice differ from helping a tenant lower furniture.
seedUse: Keep missing third elbow and rain, but tether the new rules to the original measurement instead of drifting to credentials and sleeve size.
